matching_pages_notes: Original NARA PDF pages 75 through 84 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 414 previously unaudited printed rows on pages 75-76 and 78-84 were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed spelling and initials, suffixes, rank or grade, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. Page 77 had already passed visual review and was rechecked without changing its prior decision; all 460 rows across the ten-page block agree with the current extraction. Literal source anomalies remain unchanged, including Cederrberg, Jozef, Emileo, the nine-digit Mario P Cervone number, Chadnler, Commandate, the notes French and possibly, Dreama, Champollon, Chandrasekha, Sukyoon, Aleid, A'Louise, Charpenter, the duplicated Jr. text in both fields for Leslie Cheek, Chekrezi C with A in the middle field, Saraadi, Lefty, Chittinandhan C, Waclaw with Polish Ar, Choptowich, Chrislaw and Chrislow as separate spellings, Chrysostomas, Jouis, Iganazio, Stephan M Claessens with Dutch Ar, Clainos, Clance, the nine-digit Robert E Clemens number, Claras, Acice, and Jeraldine. Private identifiers are not included in this review bundle or public assets.
